title: A blocked chat finish deletes untracked folders silently
what: When a finish is blocked (for example a repository inside the chat folder), finish_blocked lists the worktree with git status. An untracked folder is collapsed to a single entry ending in '/', and every such entry is skipped, so files such as drafts/plan.md are never copied to the kept folder. wrap_up then runs git worktree remove --force and those files are gone, with no announcement naming them.
expected: Every file under an untracked folder should be copied to the kept folder (or the folder left in place) before the worktree is removed, so a blocked finish never deletes work the user cannot get back.
